title: How to Build a Browser-Based Image Storyboard to PDF Tool Using JavaScript
summary: Before anyone films a video, shoots an ad or draws the final pages of a comic, someone usually sketches the plan as a storyboard: one picture per shot, in order, with a short note about what happens a
llm_summary: A browser‑based image storyboard‑to‑PDF tool lets creators arrange a sequence of pictures—each representing a shot or panel—directly in the web page, add brief notes, and then export the whole storyboard as a single PDF file. Using JavaScript, the app handles image uploads, drag‑and‑drop ordering, text annotations, and PDF generation entirely on the client side, so no server processing is required
